summary: Iter48 P2 cleanup + new features tested. Backend pytest 14/16 passed. All P2 cleanup targets PASS: wallet GET is now read-only with wallet_exists flag (idempotent), POS hardware cash-drawer/open + scanner/register + scanner/test all accept JSON body + optional barcode, age-verify rejects birth_year 1850 & 2099 with 400 'Geburtsjahr außerhalb gültigem Bereich' and accepts 2000 with id_checked=true. Landing chatbot + POS receipts/void regressions PASS. However, 2 LiveKit regressions FAIL with HTTP 500 because /app/backend/.env now contains LIVEKIT_URL=/ LIVEKIT_API_KEY=/ LIVEKIT_API_SECRET= as EMPTY strings, which defeats os.getenv('X', 'default') fallback (empty string is truthy-ish, returned as-is). This breaks POST /api/livekit/rooms and /api/livekit/token — and in turn cascades into the frontend LiveKit flow (see frontend issues). Frontend: /admin/landing-leads page, 4 stat cards, search, refresh, 2 lead rows all present with correct testids. /livekit-stream has livekit-stream-page + livekit-list + livekit-create-btn + modal name-input/confirm; /live-shopping correctly renders LiveKitStreamPage. After clicking create with a new room name, the room does NOT appear (because POST /api/livekit/rooms 500s) and livekit-error shows 'Failed to execute 'json' on 'Response': body stream already read' instead of the expected 'LiveKit-Server nicht konfiguriert' — so the frontend also has a response-body-consumed-twice bug in the error path.

critical.issue: 500 'url must be set' — root cause: LIVEKIT_URL in /app/backend/.env is an EMPTY STRING. os.getenv('LIVEKIT_URL', 'ws://localhost:7880') returns '' (empty), bypassing the fallback. The LiveKit SDK rejects empty URL.

500 'api_key and api_secret must be set' — same root cause. LIVEKIT_API_KEY and LIVEKIT_API_SECRET in .env are empty strings, defaults in os.getenv never kick in. Blocks the full livekit-stream host/join flow (frontend can't fetch token).

ui_bugs.issue: Error toast shows 'Failed to execute json on Response: body stream already read' on failed room creation instead of the planned 'LiveKit-Server nicht konfiguriert'. Indicates the response body is being consumed twice (e.g., .json() called after .text() or in a catch branch).

integration_issues.issue: Because POST /api/livekit/rooms 500s (backend env bug), the new room never appears in the list and livekit-host-{name}/livekit-join-{name} buttons are never rendered. Cannot complete the full create→join/host loop. Pre-existing rooms (from iter46/47) still show Zuschauen/Streamen buttons — but clicking them would also 500 on /api/livekit/token for the same reason.

action_items: FIX LIVEKIT ENV: Either (a) delete empty LIVEKIT_URL/LIVEKIT_API_KEY/LIVEKIT_API_SECRET lines from /app/backend/.env so the os.getenv defaults ('ws://localhost:7880', 'devkey', 'secret') kick in; OR (b) change livekit_streaming.py lines 45-46, 68-70, 122, 271 from os.getenv('X', 'default') to os.getenv('X') or 'default' so empty strings also fall back. rca_of_the_issue: ROOT CAUSE of the 2 livekit 500s: /app/backend/.env has `LIVEKIT_URL=`, `LIVEKIT_API_KEY=`, `LIVEKIT_API_SECRET=` with EMPTY values. Python's os.getenv(key, default) returns the default ONLY if key is absent — an empty-string value is returned verbatim. Downstream, livekit.api.LiveKitAPI('') raises 'url must be set' and api.AccessToken('','') raises 'api_key and api_secret must be set'. Reproduction: `curl -X POST /api/livekit/rooms -H 'cookie: session=...' -d '{"room_name":"x"}'` → 500. Mitigation: either remove the empty lines from .env (preferred, smallest diff — defaults already exist) OR switch all 5 os.getenv calls in livekit_streaming.py to `os.getenv(k) or default` idiom so empty strings trigger fallback too. Frontend double-read bug in LiveKitStreamPage compounds the UX: the user sees 'body stream already read' which is a JS DOM error, NOT the designed German fallback message.
